tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List the connected social accounts on this Postlia workspace.

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Create a post. Provide scheduledAt (ISO datetime) to schedule, queue=true for the next open queue slot, or neither to post within ~5 minutes. Media platforms (instagram, tiktok, pinterest, youtube) need mediaUrl/mediaUrls from upload_media; tiktok/pinterest/youtube also need their options object.

tools.name: cancel_post
tools.description: Cancel a scheduled post by id.

tools.name: upload_media
tools.description: Pull an image or video from a public https URL into Postlia storage. Returns the storage URL and media type, ready for create_post. PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, MP4, WebM, MOV, max 25 MB.

tools.name: get_post_receipt
tools.description: Delivery receipt for a post: per-platform outcome (published/failed/retrying/pending), platform post ids, and the platform's real error text. Use this to VERIFY a post actually went live instead of assuming. Accepts the id from create_post or from list_published_posts.

tools.name: list_published_posts
tools.description: Recent post history with per-post outcome status and any platform errors.

tools.name: get_posting_quota
tools.description: The posting quota that will actually be enforced: tier, posts used, limit and remaining. Check this before composing a batch instead of discovering the limit via errors.

tools.name: reschedule_post
tools.description: Move a pending scheduled post to a new future time (ISO datetime).

tools.name: update_post_content
tools.description: Rewrite a pending scheduled post's text. Platform character limits are enforced.

tools.name: list_drafts
tools.description: List saved drafts (not scheduled, cost no quota).

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Save a draft for later without spending posting quota.

tools.name: get_queue_info
tools.description: The posting schedule (timezone + weekly slots) and the next open queue slots, i.e. when a create_post with queue=true would actually publish.

tools.name: get_analytics_summary
tools.description: Post-outcome summary over the last N days: totals, published/partial/failed counts, per-platform volume, and recent platform errors.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_scheduled_posts, create_post, get_post_receipt, list_published_posts, get_posting_quota, get_analytics_summary · Public sink: create_post, cancel_post, upload_media, get_post_receipt, list_published_posts, reschedule_post, update_post_content, get_queue_info, get_analytics_summary · Destructive: delete_draft.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_scheduled_posts, create_post, get_post_receipt, list_published_posts, get_posting_quota, get_analytics_summary · Public sink: create_post, cancel_post, upload_media, get_post_receipt, list_published_posts, reschedule_post, update_post_content, get_queue_info, get_analytics_summary · Destructive: delete_draft

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_post" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Create a text post. Provide scheduledAt (ISO datetime) to schedule, queue=true for the next open queue slot, or neither to post within ~5 minutes." → after: "Create a post. Provide scheduledAt (ISO datetime) to schedule, queue=true for the next open queue slot, or neither to post within ~5 minutes. Media platforms (instagram, tiktok, pinterest, youtube) need mediaUrl/mediaUrls from upload_media; tiktok/pinterest/youtube also need their options object."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
